rationale: The assistant correctly identified F2 as electronics overheat protection and, after the customer reported the packed drawer, correctly attributed it to blocked ventilation with no part recommended. The first reply speculated about a failing fan, though only as a conditional, and the final reply was somewhat overconfident ('definitely') and did not tell the customer to clear the drawer, leave a ventilation gap per the installation instructions, or when to seek Bosch service if F2 recurs. Overall it is useful and safe but thin on actionable guidance and escalation criteria.
